commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri between Fuel Level 2 (G169) and Instrument Cluster faulty
In-tank connectivity issues to Fuel Level 2 (G169)
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  all wiring including grounds to/from Instrument Cluster and Fuel Level 2 (G169)
Kontrol edin:  applicable Measuring Block(s) or Advanced Measuring Values
Kontrol edin:  resistance specifications per the factory level repair manual using a DVOM
Kontrol edin:  for in-tank connection issues

Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Instrument cluster.
Notes
If any other functions of the Instrument Cluster are malfunctioning make sure to save a complete Auto-Scan before powering down (unplugging) the control module for at least 30 minutes to see if the problem is temporarily fixed.
If the Instrument cluster is faulty make sure the installed system can be matched using the PIN and VCDS as per our Immobilizer page.

When 00438 is found in conjunction with 00771 in the NAR market (4F) chassis A6 see TPI 2020884 to determine if the 4F0 298 200 B (or newer) repair kit is needed.
When 00438 is found in conjunction with 00771, 00439 or 00251 in the NAR market (42) chassis R8 see TPI 2022203 determine if the 420 298 200 A (or newer) repair kit is needed.
